bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 80
v="$(node -p 'Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0])' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 81
test "$v" -ge 22 || exit 82
command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 83
node --input-type=module -e 'import {setDefaultResultOrder} from "node:dns";setDefaultResultOrder("ipv4first");try{const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(9000)});process.exitCode=r.status<500?0:84}catch(e){process.exitCode=85}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 84
echo STK04_HOST_NODE_VERSION_AND_FFMPEG=PASS
echo STK04_HOST_NODE_TELEGRAM_EGRESS=PASS
